content: Kiara Sen contacted insurance agent Vikram Patel to inquire about the renewal process for her health policy, which expired on the 10th of the month. Vikram replied with an apology for the inconvenience and attached a renewal form, requesting that she fill it out and return it by the 20th of the month.

action_items: Fill out the attached renewal form
Return the renewal form by the 20th of the month
